name: German Schafkopf
summary: Four-player partnership point-trick game, forerunner of Skat and Bavarian Schafkopf, with Jacks as top trumps.
rules_text: German Schafkopf is for 4 players in two fixed partnerships sitting opposite with a 32-card pack. Each card has ace-ten values: Ace 11, Ten 10, King 4, Queen/Ober 3, Jack/Unter 2, rest 0. Rank in plain suits is Ace, King, Queen, 10, 9, 8, 7; 10 is low despite value. The four Jacks are permanent top trumps in Clubs/Acorns, Spades/Leaves, Hearts, Diamonds/Bells order. Before play a declarer is determined who names the trump suit; all cards of that suit become lower trumps below the Jacks, in the same Ace-K-etc order. Eight tricks are played; players must follow suit if possible and must follow trump if trump led. A trick is won by highest trump or highest card of led suit. The partnership taking more than 60 of 120 points wins the deal.
rating_reason: Classic ace-ten trick-taking, hidden hands, strategic partnerships
